_note: Joining dates come from company.json staffing_now (computed from order volume). Reasons are invented to fit the order and money figures in monthly_summary. Nobody should be mentioned in mail, chat or news before their joined date. Hours are the small weekly hours in company.json at scale 0.2.

staff.name: Mr Fezziwig
staff.why: He lost one sock and found that nobody sold a single one.
staff.first_job: Everything: packing, buying, answering the inbox, writing the returns note.
staff.since: Now runs the place and approves the big refunds and orders. He packs less and misses it.
staff.others_say: He is the only one who has read the whole returns policy, and he wrote it.

staff.name: Mrs Hudson
staff.why: Orders went from 31 in August 2023 to 51 in September, and returns and questions needed a person.
staff.first_job: Answer the inbox and the phone.
staff.since: Leads customer service and trains the others on how complaints are handled.
staff.others_say: She notices things before they are said.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2023-09-11, 5.6 hrs/week; monthly_summary 2023-08 orders 31, 2023-09 orders 51.

staff.name: Mr Toad
staff.why: Marketing spend had grown from £68 to £169 a month and Fezziwig wanted someone to look after it. Toad arrived with a craze for every new channel.
staff.first_job: Plan the spring search campaign and the launch of Blip.
staff.since: Runs campaigns and outreach. Learned that the gift guide email is cheap and good, and still has a new craze most quarters.
staff.others_say: He is always about to make everyone famous.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2024-01-08, 2 hrs/week; monthly_summary marketing_spend 2023-07 £68, 2023-12 £169; CMP-051 (£11, 97 orders).

staff.name: Phileas Fogg
staff.joined_note: Monday, three weeks after Blip launched.
staff.why: Orders had gone from 48 in January to 81 in March, and parcels needed stated times.
staff.since: Promises delivery times to the minute. Wrote the packing guide in May 2024.
staff.others_say: He has never once said 'around lunchtime'.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2024-03-25, 4.4 hrs/week; monthly_summary 2024-01 orders 48, 2024-03 orders 81; DOC-02 2024-05-13.

staff.name: Mole
staff.why: June 2024 was the first month over 100 orders and the stock room needed counting.
staff.since: Does the stock counts and the stock room. Knows where everything is and apologises for it.
staff.others_say: He is so quiet that the shelves seem to tidy themselves.

staff.name: Robinson Crusoe
staff.why: A Beckside order had just arrived 12 days late, and the company needed more than one supplier for each thing.
staff.first_job: Find second suppliers and start the speaker.
staff.since: Buys for the whole range. Placed the first orders with Tidewater, Glasshouse Growers, Riverstone and Tinsmith & Oven.
staff.others_say: He believes in a spare of everything.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2024-08-19, 2 hrs/week; PO-3304 (SUP-03) 12 days late, received 2024-08-30; PO-3468, PO-3904, PO-3919, PO-4006.

staff.name: Ebenezer Scrooge
staff.why: The company had lost money every month from April to August 2024 and he was asked to find out where it went.
staff.first_job: Check what each month's money did.
staff.since: Does month-end and chases late invoices. Watches the stock bought ahead of sales, as in the cash dips of Feb 2025 and Feb 2026.
staff.others_say: He will tell you the price of a biscuit before you have finished asking for one.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2024-09-16, 1.6 hrs/week; monthly_summary profit 2024-04 to 2024-08 all negative.

staff.name: Bob Cratchit
staff.why: Orders rose from 173 in October 2024 to 253 in November, and invoices and bills needed entering every day.
staff.first_job: Record supplier invoices and reconcile the books.
staff.since: Reconciles weekly and chases overdue payments politely.
staff.others_say: He never complains, and everyone worries about that.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2024-11-04, 2.8 hrs/week; monthly_summary 2024-10 orders 173, 2024-11 orders 253.

staff.name: Hephaestus
staff.why: Repairs had been done by whoever was free, and Blips and Daypacks were coming back with faults.
staff.first_job: Open the Fix Club bench and assess faults.
staff.since: Writes the quotes and repairs what the company sells.
staff.others_say: He is the only one allowed to be a little cross about plastic.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2024-12-16, 1.6 hrs/week; first repair record FIX-5101 2023-11-19 (declined); returns 2023 28, 2024 69.

staff.name: Sam Weller
staff.why: Orders were 148 a month and Mrs Hudson needed another voice on the phone after the Christmas backlog.
staff.first_job: Take calls, chat and email alongside Mrs Hudson.
staff.since: Handles returns and changed orders. Customers ask for him by name.
staff.others_say: Cheerful on the phone, and customers believe him.
staff.evidence: company.json joined 2025-02-24, 5.6 hrs/week; monthly_summary 2025-02 orders 148; returns 2025 104.

staff.name: Esther Summerson
staff.why: July 2025 had 210 orders, the most in a summer month, and mornings on the phone were not covered.
staff.first_job: Work through the oldest open cases and take the phone on mornings.
staff.since: Now takes the harder cases. Stays kind to people who are not kind to her.
staff.others_say: She would apologise to a parcel.
